question: Do A11 and M11 physically read the fresh selected-writer signal, individually and complementarily, rather than merely receiving exact Shapley credit in the opened OOD game?

searched: all temporal/is-was reader mediation, complete-module, exact-factor, and rescue priors/results
P7 leave-one-out null and exact source-conditioned live-module effect game v1/v2
v4-v17 is/was capability banks and all sealed-construction records
shap_tensor.md, AGENT_BOARD, BILIN18_CONNECTION, BENCHMARK_BACKLOG, and canonical dossier
prior_art.collision_result: No existing experiment combines source-absent normalized-reader replacement with source-present complete-output rescue for A11/M11 on an unopened bank.
prior_art.known_lessons: Shapley credit allocates dependence but is not a directed edge. A11 reads at block11.attn while its complete residual write exits block11.attn.c_proj; M11 reads and writes at block11.mlp. Arm-local baselines, exact answer-position footprints, causal order, and capability-before-causality are mandatory.

eligibility: A separate atomic binding may be created only after the immutable v17 capability receipt is a screen with all four registered predictions true and causal_outcomes_opened=false. The binding records the receipt SHA-256. Otherwise this causal experiment remains closed.

frozen_population.rows: All sixteen A2 rows from v17, without capability-row filtering: groups 0-7 are FIT and 8-15 HOLDOUT.
frozen_population.construction: As of now / At that time, with equal paired token lengths and a contiguous three-token changed cue span.
frozen_population.source: Capture native base and donor complete L7H7/L9H4 head outputs. On base rows, install donor-minus-base head-output deltas in increasing layer order at the established is/was postcue positions, then capture its block-10 entry. Every reader arm replays that same captured source-present block-10 entry.
frozen_population.positions: Replace only tokens 0..query at block-10 and downstream reader/write boundaries. Source head deltas are confined to the frozen postcue span.

metrics.reference: The captured selected-writer margin delta relative to native base, separately on frozen FIT/HOLDOUT.
metrics.rescue_fraction: dot(rescue_delta-loss_delta, reference)/dot(writer_delta-loss_delta, reference), with a positive denominator required.
metrics.joint_excess: loss(A11+M11) - loss(A11) - loss(M11). Positive values are physical complementarity under removal.
metrics.geometry: Also report cosine, relative residual, and per-row direction agreement against the writer reference.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_source_repla: All hashes/binding/population/positions pass; writer replay and source-absent A11+M11 self-clamp are within 1e-5; every requested hook fires once and cleans up; all metrics are finite; exact price holds.
predictions.pred_b_A11_reader_loss_is_stable_and_com: A11 loss is at least .08 on FIT and HOLDOUT; its output rescue reaches at least .70 of that loss with cosine at least .95 and recovery within .10 of writer on both.
predictions.pred_c_M11_reader_loss_is_stable_and_com: M11 loss is at least .06 on FIT and HOLDOUT; its output rescue reaches at least .70 of that loss with cosine at least .95 and recovery within .10 of writer on both.
predictions.pred_d_joint_A11_M11_loss_physically_rep: Joint loss exceeds the sum of singleton losses by at least .02 on FIT and HOLDOUT, and rescuing both outputs restores the writer bars.
predictions.pred_e_matched_attention_and_mlp_control: Absolute reader-loss effect is at most .03 for A12 and M16 on both splits; their same-site rescues restore the writer bars.

null: A valid failure of B or C rejects that directed module edge on this fresh bank. A valid D failure rejects transfer of the A11/M11 complementarity sign to physical reader removal. A valid E failure identifies an unmodeled neighboring/background route and prevents a selective edge claim. None may be repaired by row filtering or threshold changes.
decision: A-E supports a fresh held-out directed A11/M11 reader interface and licenses restricted checkpoint write/read/bilinear tensor construction. Partial passes preserve only the corresponding edge; any failed site remains a Shapley dependence nomination, not a directed edge.
